meta.name: release-notes
meta.description: Generates polished GitHub release notes for a ToolHive release by analyzing every merged PR, cross-referencing linked issues, dispatching expert agents to assess breaking changes, and producing a formatted release body. Use when the user provides a GitHub release URL, tag name, or says "release notes".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动生成 GitHub 发布说明
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果每次发版都要手动整理 PR 和 issue 来写发布说明
copy.tagline_en: Automatically generate polished GitHub release notes
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you manually compile PRs and issues for release notes every time

howto.what: Claude 会分析 GitHub 上两个版本标签之间的所有合并 PR，自动分类为破坏性变更、弃用、新功能、Bug 修复等，并生成格式化的发布说明。
howto.when: 当你提供 GitHub 发布链接（如 https://github.com/stacklok/toolhive/releases/tag/v0.18.0）或标签名（如 v0.18.0），或说出“release notes”时触发。

say.text: 帮我生成 v0.18.0 的发布说明。

howto.what_en: Claude analyzes all merged PRs between two GitHub version tags, classifies them into breaking changes, deprecations, new features, bug fixes, etc., and generates formatted release notes.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you provide a GitHub release URL (e.g., https://github.com/stacklok/toolhive/releases/tag/v0.18.0) or a tag name (e.g., v0.18.0), or say "release notes".

say_en.note: Claude analyzes all PRs between v0.18.0 and the previous tag.
Claude extracts the tag and drafts release notes.
